```{r setup, include=FALSE}

packages <- c("tidyverse", "survival", "data.table", "broom", "tableone", "flextable", "purrr", "officer")
install_if_missing <- function(package) {
  if (!require(package, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(package, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

sapply(packages, install_if_missing)
```

```{r}
## Create time-varying exposure dataframe
cohort <- cohort %>%
    ungroup %>%
  left_join(comorb_base) %>%
  filter(rx_antithyroid_exclusion!=1) %>%
  mutate(# Calculate censoring date — minimum of 1 year after last TSH or last encounter
        censor_date = end_obs_date,
        race_cat  = relevel(factor(race_cat),  ref = "White"),
        hispanic  = relevel(factor(hispanic),  ref = "Not Hispanic")
    ,
    
    # Ensure event is integer
    cv_event = as.integer(cv_event),
    
    surv_time = case_when(
      cv_event == 1 ~ time_to_first_cv,
      cv_event == 0 ~ as.numeric(as.Date(censor_date) - as.Date(first_tsh_lab)),
      TRUE          ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Verify — check for issues
cohort %>%
  summarise(
    n               = n(),
    n_events        = sum(cv_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    pct_events      = round(mean(cv_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    n_negative_time = sum(surv_time < 0,  na.rm = TRUE),
    n_zero_time     = sum(surv_time == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_missing_time  = sum(is.na(surv_time)),
    median_time     = median(surv_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_time        = min(surv_time,    na.rm = TRUE),
    max_time        = max(surv_time,    na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# Check time distribution by event status
cohort %>%
  group_by(cv_event) %>%
  summarise(
    n           = n(),
    median_time = median(surv_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    q1          = quantile(surv_time, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q3          = quantile(surv_time, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_time    = min(surv_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_time    = max(surv_time, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups     = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# ---- 1. Yearly proportion of time above range (12 x 30-day blocks) ------
yearly <- tir_interpolated_blocks %>%
  group_by(episode_id, period) %>%
  summarise(
    n_blocks = n(),
    n_labs   = sum(!is.na(tsh_value)),                   # real labs behind the year
    TAR_A   = mean(TAR_A),                              
    TIR_A   = mean(TIR_A),
    TBR_A   = mean(TBR_A),
    TAR_B   = mean(TAR_B),                              
    TIR_B   = mean(TIR_B),
    TBR_B   = mean(TBR_B),
    TAR_C   = mean(TAR_C),                              
    TIR_C   = mean(TIR_C),
    TBR_C   = mean(TBR_C),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_blocks >= 6) 

yearly_v2 <-  tir_interpolated_blocks_v2 %>%
  group_by(episode_id, period) %>%
  summarise(
    n_blocks_v2 = n(),
    n_labs_v2   = sum(!is.na(tsh_value_v2)),                   # real labs behind the year
    TAR_A_v2   = mean(TAR_A_v2),                              
    TIR_A_v2   = mean(TIR_A_v2),
    TBR_A_v2   = mean(TBR_A_v2),
    TAR_B_v2   = mean(TAR_B_v2),                              
    TIR_B_v2   = mean(TIR_B_v2),
    TBR_B_v2   = mean(TBR_B_v2),
    TAR_C_v2   = mean(TAR_C_v2),                              
    TIR_C_v2   = mean(TIR_C_v2),
    TBR_C_v2   = mean(TBR_C_v2),
    .groups  = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(n_blocks_v2 >= 6)    

yearly <- left_join(yearly, yearly_v2)

# ---- 2. Person-year follow-up, exposure = PREVIOUS year -----------------
base <- cohort %>% ungroup() %>% distinct(episode_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(cap_id, episode_id, surv_time, cv_event, race_cat, hispanic, sex, age_enc, rx_vars)

tv <- base %>%
  mutate(max_period = ceiling(surv_time / 360)) %>%
  uncount(max_period, .id = "period") %>%                    # one row per year of follow-up
  mutate(tstart = (period - 1) * 360,
         tstop  = pmin(period * 360, surv_time),
         event_tv = as.integer(cv_event == 1 & tstop >= surv_time)) %>%
  filter(tstart < tstop) %>%
  left_join(yearly %>% mutate(period = period + 1),          # shift: year k exposure -> year k+1 follow-up
            by = c("episode_id", "period")) %>%
  filter(period >= 2) %>%                                  # year 1 has no prior-year exposure
    mutate(TIR_A_10 = TIR_A * 10,
         TIR_B_10 = TIR_B * 10,
         TIR_C_10 = TIR_C * 10,
         TAR_A_10 = TAR_A * 10,
         TAR_B_10 = TAR_B * 10,
         TAR_C_10 = TAR_C * 10,
         TBR_A_10 = TBR_A * 10,
         TBR_B_10 = TBR_B * 10,
         TBR_C_10 = TBR_C * 10,
       TIR_A_10_v2 = TIR_A_v2 * 10,
         TIR_B_10_v2 = TIR_B_v2 * 10,
         TIR_C_10_v2 = TIR_C_v2 * 10,
         TAR_A_10_v2 = TAR_A_v2 * 10,
         TAR_B_10_v2 = TAR_B_v2 * 10,
         TAR_C_10_v2 = TAR_C_v2 * 10,
         TBR_A_10_v2 = TBR_A_v2 * 10,
         TBR_B_10_v2 = TBR_B_v2 * 10,
        TBR_C_10_v2 = TBR_C_v2 * 10)  

tv %>%
  summarise(
    max_tstart   = max(tstart),
    max_tstop    = max(tstop),
    max_surv     = max(surv_time),
    mean_interval = round(mean(tstop - tstart), 1)
  )

## Add comorbidities
tv <- tv %>%
  left_join(comorb_days, by = "cap_id") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(paste0("dxday_", comorb_vars)),
                ~ as.integer(!is.na(.x) & .x <= tstart),
                .names = "{sub('dxday_', '', .col)}_tv")) %>%
  select(-starts_with("dxday_"))

## Add Meds
day_cols <- setdiff(grep("^day_", names(med_days), value = TRUE), "day_rx_antithyroid_exclusion")
rx_stem  <- sub("^day_", "", day_cols)
rx_tv_vars   <- paste0(rx_stem, "_tv")
rx_base_vars <- paste0(rx_stem, "_base")

tv <- tv %>%
  left_join(med_days %>% select(episode_id, all_of(day_cols)), by = "episode_id") %>%
  mutate(
    # time-varying: first prescription on or before the interval start
    across(all_of(day_cols), ~ as.integer(!is.na(.x) & .x <= tstart),
           .names = "{sub('^day_', '', .col)}_tv"),
    # baseline: first prescription on or before time zero, fixed over follow-up
    across(all_of(day_cols), ~ as.integer(!is.na(.x) & .x <= 0),
           .names = "{sub('^day_', '', .col)}_base")
  ) %>%
  select(-all_of(day_cols))

n_pos_base <- tv %>%
  distinct(episode_id, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  select(all_of(rx_base_vars)) %>%
  colSums()

rx_keep_base <- rx_base_vars[n_pos_base >= 50]     # adjust the minimum as needed
rx_keep_base

saveRDS(tv, file.path(output_folder, "time_varying_analytic_df.Rds"))
```

```{r}
summary_tir <- tv %>% group_by(cap_id, episode_id) %>%
  summarise(n_blocks = sum(n_blocks),
    n_labs   = sum(n_labs),                   # real labs behind the year
    TAR_A   = mean(TAR_A),                              
    TIR_A   = mean(TIR_A),
    TBR_A   = mean(TBR_A),
    TAR_B   = mean(TAR_B),                              
    TIR_B   = mean(TIR_B),
    TBR_B   = mean(TBR_B),
    TAR_C   = mean(TAR_C),                              
    TIR_C   = mean(TIR_C),
    TBR_C   = mean(TBR_C),
    TAR_A_v2   = mean(TAR_A_v2),                              
    TIR_A_v2   = mean(TIR_A_v2),
    TBR_A_v2   = mean(TBR_A_v2),
    TAR_B_v2   = mean(TAR_B_v2),                              
    TIR_B_v2   = mean(TIR_B_v2),
    TBR_B_v2   = mean(TBR_B_v2),
    TAR_C_v2   = mean(TAR_C_v2),                              
    TIR_C_v2   = mean(TIR_C_v2),
    TBR_C_v2   = mean(TBR_C_v2),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

cohort <- left_join(summary_tir, cohort)
# ---- 1. Labels ---------------------------------------------------------
comorb_lab <- c(anemia = "Anemia", cvd = "Cardiovascular disease (baseline)", ckd = "CKD",
  dementia = "Dementia", dm1 = "Diabetes mellitus type 1", dm2 = "Diabetes mellitus type 2",
  ibd = "GI disease - IBD and intestinal malabsorption", pud = "GI disease - peptic ulcer disease",
  hld = "Hyperlipidemia", htn = "Hypertension", liver = "Liver disease", malignancy = "Malignancy",
  mdd_anx = "MDD/Anxiety", obesity = "Obesity", oa = "Osteoarthritis", osteoporosis = "Osteoporosis",
  pregnancy = "Pregnancy (active - censoring event)", pulm = "Pulmonary disease",
  ra_ctd = "Rheumatoid arthritis and other CTD", sleep = "Sleep disorders")

base_use <- setdiff(base_vars, "NA_base")                       # drops the NA group column
names(base_use) <- comorb_lab[sub("_base$", "", base_use)]      # nice names
base_use <- base_use[!is.na(names(base_use))]

# medication nice names come from the category names themselves
base_flags <- med_days %>%
  transmute(episode_id,
            across(all_of(day_cols), ~ as.integer(!is.na(.x) & .x <= 0),
                   .names = "{sub('^day_', '', .col)}_base"))

rx_base_vars <- setdiff(names(base_flags), "episode_id")
rx_keep_base <- rx_base_vars[colSums(base_flags[, rx_base_vars]) >= 50]
cohort <- cohort %>%
  left_join(base_flags, by = "episode_id") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(rx_base_vars), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)))

tir  <- c("TIR_A","TAR_A","TBR_A","TIR_B","TAR_B","TBR_B","TIR_C","TAR_C","TBR_C")
mk_tir <- function(suffix = "") {
  one <- function(prefix) setNames(paste0(prefix, "_", c("A", "B", "C"), suffix),
                                   paste("Method", c("A", "B", "C")))
  list("Time in range"       = one("TIR"),
       "Time above range"    = one("TAR"),
       "Time below range"    = one("TBR"))
}
base_use <- base_use[order(tolower(names(base_use)))]
rx_use   <- rx_use[order(tolower(names(rx_use)))]
groups <- list(
  "Observation Characteristics" = c("Blocks, n" = "n_blocks", "TSH labs, n" = "n_labs",
                                    "Follow-up, days" = "surv_time"),
  "Time In Range, Linear Rise, %" = mk_tir(""),
  "Time In Range, Quick Rise, %"  = mk_tir("_v2"),
  "Cardiovascular Outcomes" = c("Atrial fibrillation, n (%)" = "afib", "Stroke, n (%)" = "stroke",
                                "Myocardial infarction, n (%)" = "mi", "Heart Failure, n (%)" = "hf"),
  "Baseline Comorbidities, n (%)" = base_use,
  "Medication Exposures, n (%)" = rx_use,
  "Demographics" = c("Race, n (%)" = "race_cat", "Ethnicity, n (%)" = "hispanic",
                     "Sex (male), n (%)" = "sex", "Age at Hypothyroidism Diagnosis, years" = "age_enc")
)
all_v <- unlist(groups, use.names = FALSE)

# ---- 2. tableone -------------------------------------------------------
d <- cohort %>% ungroup() %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(c(tir, paste0(tir, "_v2"))), ~ .x * 100))        # proportions -> %

cont_v <- c("n_blocks", "n_labs", "surv_time", "age_enc", tir, paste0(tir, "_v2"))
cat_v   <- setdiff(all_v, cont_v)
nonnorm <- intersect(cont_v, all_v)

t2 <- CreateTableOne(vars = all_v, strata = "cv_event", data = d,
                     factorVars = cat_v, addOverall = TRUE)
m <- print(t2, showAllLevels = FALSE, nonnormal = nonnorm, catDigits = 1, contDigits = 1,
           pDigits = 3, smd = TRUE, test = TRUE, printToggle = FALSE, explain = FALSE,
           formatOptions = list(big.mark = ","))

# ---- 3. Clean the matrix ----------------------------------------------
fmt_commas <- function(s) {
  s <- as.character(s)
  mt <- gregexpr("(?<![\\d.,])\\d{4,}(?!\\d)", s, perl = TRUE)
  regmatches(s, mt) <- lapply(regmatches(s, mt), function(v)
    format(as.numeric(v), big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE, trim = TRUE))
  s
}
rn <- rownames(m); is_level <- grepl("^\\s", rn); nm <- trimws(rn)
var_of <- ifelse(is_level, NA, sub(" = .*$| \\(.*$", "", nm))

keep <- intersect(c("Overall", "0", "1", "p", "SMD"), colnames(m))
df <- as.data.frame(m[, keep, drop = FALSE], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) trimws(gsub("\\(\\s+", "(", fmt_commas(x))))
df$p[df$p == "NA"] <- ""; df$SMD[df$SMD == "NA"] <- ""

# integer-like variables: drop ".0"
int_rows <- which(var_of %in% c("n_blocks","n_labs","surv_time","age_enc"))
df[int_rows, c("Overall","0","1")] <- lapply(df[int_rows, c("Overall","0","1")],
                                             function(x) gsub("\\.0(?!\\d)", "", x, perl = TRUE))

# ---- 4. Assemble rows by group ----------------------------------------
blank <- function() setNames(rep("", ncol(df)), names(df))
rows <- list(); kind <- character()
add <- function(lbl, vals, k) {
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <<- c(Characteristic = lbl, vals)
  kind <<- c(kind, k)
}

# one variable: its row, plus any nested factor levels
add_var <- function(lbl, v, k) {
  i <- which(var_of == v)
  if (!length(i)) return(invisible())
  add(lbl, unlist(df[i[1], ]), k)
  j <- i[1] + 1
  while (j <= nrow(df) && is_level[j]) { add(nm[j], unlist(df[j, ]), "level"); j <- j + 1 }
}

for (g in names(groups)) {
  add(g, blank(), "group")
  items <- groups[[g]]
  if (is.list(items)) {                          # time-in-range sections: measure -> methods
    for (measure in names(items)) {
      add(measure, blank(), "sub")
      for (meth in names(items[[measure]])) add_var(meth, items[[measure]][[meth]], "method")
    }
  } else {                                       # all other sections
    for (lbl in names(items)) add_var(lbl, items[[lbl]], "char")
  }
}
out <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, rows), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
nn <- unlist(df[which(nm == "n")[1], c("Overall", "0", "1")])
names(out) <- c("Characteristic", keep)

ft <- flextable(out) %>%
  set_header_labels(Characteristic = "Characteristic",
                    Overall = paste0("Overall\n(n = ", nn[1], ")"),
                    `0` = paste0("No CV event\n(n = ", nn[2], ")"),
                    `1` = paste0("CV event\n(n = ", nn[3], ")"),
                    p = "p-value") %>%
  italic(i = which(kind == "group"), j = 1) %>%
  bold(i = which(kind %in% c("char", "sub")), j = 1) %>%
  padding(i = which(kind %in% c("char", "sub")), j = 1, padding.left = 10) %>%
  padding(i = which(kind %in% c("method", "level")), j = 1, padding.left = 24) %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(j = -1, align = "center", part = "all") %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding.top = 1, padding.bottom = 1, part = "all") %>%
  add_footer_lines(c("Median [IQR] for continuous variables; n (%) for categorical variables. Binary variables show the '1' level.",
                     "SMD = standardized mean difference (CV event vs. no CV event). Methods A, B, and C are the three TSH range definitions.")) %>%
  autofit()
ft
flextable::save_as_docx(ft, path = file.path(results, "table1.docx"))
```


# Unadjusted continuous - TIR method 1
```{r}
exposures <- paste0(rep(c("TIR", "TAR", "TBR"), each = 3), "_", c("A", "B", "C"), "_10")

fit_one <- function(x) {
  f <- coxph(reformulate(x, response = "Surv(tstart, tstop, event_tv)"),
             data = tv, cluster = cap_id)
  tidy(f, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == x) %>%
    mutate(exposure = x)
}

res <- map_dfr(exposures, fit_one) %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = c(TIR = "Time in range", TAR = "Time above range",
                TBR = "Time below range")[substr(exposure, 1, 3)],
    Method  = paste("Method", substr(exposure, 5, 5)),
    HR      = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    p       = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p.value)),
    sig     = p.value < 0.05
  )

wide <- res %>%
  select(Method, Measure, HR, p) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Measure, values_from = c(HR, p), names_glue = "{Measure}_{.value}") %>%
  select(Method,
         `Time in range_HR`, `Time in range_p`,
         `Time above range_HR`, `Time above range_p`,
         `Time below range_HR`, `Time below range_p`)

# 3. Flextable
ft <- flextable(wide) %>%
  set_header_labels(Method = "Method",
                    `Time in range_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Time in range_p` = "p",
                    `Time above range_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Time above range_p` = "p",
                    `Time below range_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Time below range_p` = "p") %>%
  add_header_row(values = c("", "Time in range", "Time above range", "Time below range"),
                 colwidths = c(1, 2, 2, 2)) %>%
  set_caption("Association of time in range with cardiovascular events (unadjusted)") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(part = "header", align = "center") %>%
  align(j = 2:7, align = "center", part = "body") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3, part = "all") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  hline_top(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "body", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
  add_footer_lines(c(
    "Unadjusted Cox proportional hazards models with time-varying exposure; each cell is a separate model.",
    "HR = hazard ratio per 10 percentage-point increase in the proportion of the prior year; robust standard errors clustered by patient. Bold = p < 0.05.",
    "Methods A, B, and C are the three TSH range definitions (A: 0.4-4.5, B: 0.1-10, C: 0.4-6 mIU/L).")) %>%
  autofit()

# 4. Bold significant results
sig <- res %>% filter(sig)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sig))) {
  r <- which(wide$Method == sig$Method[i])
  ft <- bold(ft, i = r, j = paste0(sig$Measure[i], c("_HR", "_p")), part = "body")
}
ft

save_as_docx(ft, path = file.path(results, "cox_tir_tar_tbr_unadjusted.docx"))
```

# Adjusted continuous - TIR method 1
```{r cox regressions}
exposures <- paste0(rep(c("TIR", "TAR", "TBR"), each = 3), "_", c("A", "B", "C"), "_10")
covs_tv   <- paste0(comorb_vars, "_tv")

# 1. Fit models, keeping ALL terms
run_cox_all <- function(x, data) {
  fit <- coxph(reformulate(c(x, "race_cat", "hispanic", "sex", "age_enc", covs_tv, rx_tv_vars),
                           response = "Surv(tstart, tstop, event_tv)"),
               data = data, cluster = cap_id)
  tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(exposure = x, is_exposure = term == x)
}
res_all <- map_dfr(exposures, run_cox_all, data = tv)   # tv must hold the _tv and rx columns

label_term <- function(term, measure) {
  case_when(
    grepl("^T(IR|AR|BR)_[ABC]_10$", term) ~ paste0(measure, " (per 10 percentage points)"),
    term == "race_catAsian" ~ "Race: Asian (vs. White)",
    term == "race_catBlack or African American" ~ "Race: Black or African American",
    term == "race_catOther" ~ "Race: Other",
    term == "race_catUnknown" ~ "Race: Unknown",
    term == "hispanicHispanic" ~ "Ethnicity: Hispanic (vs. not Hispanic)",
    term == "hispanicUnknown" ~ "Ethnicity: Unknown",
    term == "sexM" ~ "Sex: Male (vs. female)",
    term == "age_enc" ~ "Age at encounter (per year)",
    sub("_tv$", "", term) %in% names(comorb_lab) & grepl("_tv$", term) ~
      paste0("Comorbidity: ", comorb_lab[sub("_tv$", "", term)]),
    term %in% names(rx_lab) ~ paste0("Medication: ", rx_lab[term]),
    TRUE ~ term)
}

res_all <- res_all %>%
  mutate(Measure = c(TIR = "Time in range", TAR = "Time above range",
                     TBR = "Time below range")[substr(exposure, 1, 3)],
         Method  = paste("Method", substr(exposure, 5, 5)),
         label   = label_term(term, Measure[1]),
         HR      = ifelse(is.na(estimate), "", sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high)),
         p       = ifelse(is.na(p.value), "", ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))),
         sig     = !is.na(p.value) & p.value < 0.05) %>%
  group_by(Measure) %>%
  mutate(label = ifelse(is_exposure, paste0(Measure, " (per 10 percentage points)"), label)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Row order: exposure, demographics, comorbidities (A-Z), medications (A-Z)
order_key <- function(lbl, is_exp) {
  grp <- case_when(is_exp ~ 0, grepl("^(Race|Ethnicity|Sex|Age)", lbl) ~ 1,
                   grepl("^Comorbidity", lbl) ~ 2, grepl("^Medication", lbl) ~ 3, TRUE ~ 4)
  paste0(grp, tolower(lbl))
}

# One flextable per measure
make_ft <- function(meas) {
  d <- res_all %>% filter(Measure == meas)
  wide <- d %>% select(label, is_exposure, Method, HR, p) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = c(HR, p), names_glue = "{Method}_{.value}") %>%
    arrange(order_key(label, is_exposure))
  sigw <- d %>% filter(sig) %>% select(label, Method)

  ft <- flextable(wide %>% select(label, starts_with("Method A"), starts_with("Method B"),
                                  starts_with("Method C"))) %>%
    set_header_labels(label = "Characteristic",
                      `Method A_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Method A_p` = "p",
                      `Method B_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Method B_p` = "p",
                      `Method C_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Method C_p` = "p") %>%
    add_header_row(values = c("", "Method A", "Method B", "Method C"), colwidths = c(1, 2, 2, 2)) %>%
    set_caption(paste0("Adjusted Cox models: ", tolower(meas), " and cardiovascular events")) %>%
    bold(part = "header") %>% align(part = "header", align = "center") %>%
    align(j = 2:7, align = "center", part = "body") %>%
    bold(i = which(wide$is_exposure), part = "body") %>%
    fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") %>%
    padding(padding.top = 1, padding.bottom = 1, part = "all") %>%
    border_remove() %>%
    hline_top(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
    hline_bottom(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1)) %>%
    hline_bottom(part = "body", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
    add_footer_lines(c("Each Method column is a separate Cox model with time-varying exposure; robust SEs clustered by patient.",
                       "Adjusted for all variables listed. HR = hazard ratio. Bold = p < 0.05 (covariates) or exposure row.",
                       "Methods A, B, C: TSH range definitions (A: 0.4-4.5, B: 0.1-10, C: 0.4-6 mIU/L).")) %>%
    width(j = 1, width = 3) %>% width(j = c(2, 4, 6), width = 1.3) %>% width(j = c(3, 5, 7), width = 0.55)

  for (m in c("Method A", "Method B", "Method C")) {
    r <- which(wide$label %in% sigw$label[sigw$Method == m])
    ft <- bold(ft, i = r, j = paste0(m, c("_HR", "_p")), part = "body")
  }
  ft
}

ft_tir <- make_ft("Time in range")
ft_tar <- make_ft("Time above range")
ft_tbr <- make_ft("Time below range")

save_as_docx("Time in range" = ft_tir, "Time above range" = ft_tar, "Time below range" = ft_tbr,
             path = file.path(results, "cox_tir_tar_tbr_adjusted_all_terms.docx"),
             pr_section = prop_section(page_size = page_size(orient = "landscape")))
```



# Sensitivity analysis, baseline comorbidities only - TIR method 1
```{r}

tv_b <- tv %>%
  left_join(comorb_base, by = "cap_id") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(base_vars), ~ coalesce(.x, 0L)))

f_base <- reformulate(c("TAR_A_10", "race_cat", "hispanic", "sex", "age_enc", base_vars),
                      response = "Surv(tstart, tstop, event_tv)")
cox_base <- coxph(f_base, data = tv_b, cluster = cap_id)

# Compare the exposure estimate across the three specifications
cox_none <- coxph(Surv(tstart, tstop, event_tv) ~ TAR_A_10 + race_cat + hispanic + sex + age_enc,
                  data = tv_b, cluster = cap_id)
cox_tv  <- coxph(reformulate(c("TAR_A_10", "race_cat", "hispanic", "sex", "age_enc", covs_tv, rx_keep),
                              response = "Surv(tstart, tstop, event_tv)"),
                  data = tv, cluster = cap_id)   

bind_rows(
  broom::tidy(cox_none, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "No comorbidities"),
  broom::tidy(cox_base, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Baseline comorbidities"),
  broom::tidy(cox_tv,  exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>% mutate(model = "Time-varying comorbidities")
) %>% filter(term == "TAR_A_10") %>%
  transmute(model, HR = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high))
```

# Sensitivity analysis, categorical exposure - TIR method 1
```{r}

exposures <- paste0(rep(c("TIR","TAR","TBR"), each = 3), "_", c("A","B","C"), "_10")

# Category builder
# x is on the 0-10 scale, so pct = % of the prior year (0-100)
make_cat <- function(x, type) {
  pct <- round(x * 10, 6)                     # avoids floating-point misses at 0 and 100
  if (type == "TIR") {
    # reference = fully in range; categories describe time OUT of range getting larger
    factor(case_when(pct == 100 ~ "100% (ref)",
                     pct > 75   ~ ">75-<100%",
                     pct > 50   ~ ">50-75%",
                     pct > 25   ~ ">25-50%",
                     TRUE       ~ "0-25%"),
           levels = c("100% (ref)", ">75-<100%", ">50-75%", ">25-50%", "0-25%"))
  } else {
    # TAR and TBR: reference = no time above/below range
    factor(case_when(pct == 0   ~ "0% (ref)",
                     pct <= 25  ~ ">0-25%",
                     pct <= 50  ~ ">25-50%",
                     pct < 100  ~ ">50-<100%",
                     TRUE       ~ "100%"),
           levels = c("0% (ref)", ">0-25%", ">25-50%", ">50-<100%", "100%"))
  }
}

# Model for one exposure
run_cox_cat <- function(x, data) {
  d <- data
  d$exp_cat <- make_cat(d[[x]], substr(x, 1, 3))

  covs <- c("race_cat", "hispanic", "sex", "age_enc", covs_tv, rx_keep)
  f <- reformulate(c("exp_cat", covs), response = "Surv(tstart, tstop, event_tv)")
  fit <- coxph(f, data = d, cluster = cap_id)

  # Trend: category rank entered as a single numeric term
  d$exp_score <- as.integer(d$exp_cat) - 1
  fit_tr <- coxph(reformulate(c("exp_score", covs), response = "Surv(tstart, tstop, event_tv)"),
                  data = d, cluster = cap_id)
  p_trend <- summary(fit_tr)$coefficients["exp_score", "Pr(>|z|)"]

  counts <- d %>% group_by(category = exp_cat) %>%
    summarise(person_years = n(), events = sum(event_tv), .groups = "drop")

  est <- broom::tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(grepl("^exp_cat", term)) %>%
    transmute(category = sub("^exp_cat", "", term),
              HR = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
              p  = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p.value)))

  counts %>%
    mutate(category = as.character(category)) %>%
    left_join(est, by = "category") %>%
    mutate(HR = ifelse(is.na(HR), "1.00 (ref)", HR),
           p  = ifelse(is.na(p), "", p),
           exposure = x,
           p_trend = ifelse(p_trend < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_trend))) %>%
    select(exposure, category, person_years, events, HR, p, p_trend)
}

# Run for all nine exposures 
results_cat <- map_dfr(exposures, run_cox_cat, data = tv)

meas_lab <- c(TIR = "Time in range", TAR = "Time above range", TBR = "Time below range")

res <- results_cat %>%
  mutate(Measure = meas_lab[substr(exposure, 1, 3)],
         Method  = paste("Method", substr(exposure, 5, 5)),
         cell    = HR,
         ev      = format(events, big.mark = ","),
         py      = format(person_years, big.mark = ","),
         order   = match(category, unique(category)))

# category order within each measure (as built by make_cat)
cat_order <- res %>% distinct(Measure, category) %>%
  group_by(Measure) %>% mutate(ord = row_number()) %>% ungroup()

wide <- res %>%
  select(Measure, category, Method, HR, p, ev, py) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Method, values_from = c(HR, p, ev, py),
              names_glue = "{Method}_{.value}") %>%
  left_join(cat_order, by = c("Measure", "category")) %>%
  arrange(factor(Measure, levels = meas_lab), ord)

trend <- res %>% distinct(Measure, Method, p_trend) %>%
  group_by(Measure) %>%
  summarise(txt = paste0(sub("Method ", "", Method), ": ", p_trend, collapse = "; "),
            .groups = "drop")

# Build rows: a header row per measure, then its categories
rows <- list(); kind <- character()
for (m in meas_lab) {
  tt <- trend$txt[trend$Measure == m]
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(Category = paste0(m, "  (p for trend, ", tt, ")"),
    `Method A_HR` = "", `Method A_p` = "", `Method A_ev` = "",
    `Method B_HR` = "", `Method B_p` = "", `Method B_ev` = "",
    `Method C_HR` = "", `Method C_p` = "", `Method C_ev` = "")
  kind <- c(kind, "hdr")
  d <- wide %>% filter(Measure == m)
  rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- d %>% transmute(Category = category,
    `Method A_HR`, `Method A_p`, `Method A_ev`,
    `Method B_HR`, `Method B_p`, `Method B_ev`,
    `Method C_HR`, `Method C_p`, `Method C_ev`)
  kind <- c(kind, rep("row", nrow(d)))
}
out <- bind_rows(rows)

ft <- flextable(out) %>%
  set_header_labels(Category = "Share of prior year",
    `Method A_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Method A_p` = "p", `Method A_ev` = "Events",
    `Method B_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Method B_p` = "p", `Method B_ev` = "Events",
    `Method C_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Method C_p` = "p", `Method C_ev` = "Events") %>%
  add_header_row(values = c("", "Method A", "Method B", "Method C"), colwidths = c(1, 3, 3, 3)) %>%
  set_caption("Cardiovascular events by category of time in, above, and below TSH range in the prior year") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>% align(part = "header", align = "center") %>%
  align(j = 2:10, align = "center", part = "body") %>%
  bold(i = which(kind == "hdr"), part = "body") %>%
  italic(i = which(kind == "hdr"), j = 1, part = "body") %>%
  padding(i = which(kind == "row"), j = 1, padding.left = 18) %>%
  fontsize(size = 9, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding.top = 2, padding.bottom = 2, part = "all") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  hline_top(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "body", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
  add_footer_lines(c(
    "Cox models with time-varying exposure, adjusted for race, ethnicity, sex, age, and time-varying comorbidities; robust SEs clustered by patient.",
    "Reference: 0% above/below range (TAR, TBR) or 100% in range (TIR, where categories show increasing time out of range). Events = events in that category.",
    "Methods A, B, C: TSH range definitions (A: 0.4-4.5, B: 0.1-10, C: 0.4-6 mIU/L).")) %>%
  autofit()
ft

save_as_docx(ft, path = file.path(results, "cox_categorical_exposures.docx"),
             pr_section = prop_section(page_size = page_size(orient = "landscape")))
```

# Sensitivity analysis, adjusted continuous - TIR method 2
```{r cox regressions}
exposures <- paste0(rep(c("TIR", "TAR", "TBR"), each = 3), "_", c("A", "B", "C"), "_10_v2")
covs_tv   <- paste0(comorb_vars, "_tv")

run_cox <- function(x, data) {
  fit <- coxph(reformulate(c(x, "race_cat", "hispanic", "sex", "age_enc", covs_tv, rx_keep),
                           response = "Surv(tstart, tstop, event_tv)"),
               data = data, cluster = cap_id)
  tidy(fit, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    filter(term == x) %>%
    transmute(exposure = x, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value)
}

res <- map_dfr(exposures, run_cox, data = tv) %>%
  mutate(
    Measure = c(TIR = "Time in range", TAR = "Time above range",
                TBR = "Time below range")[substr(exposure, 1, 3)],
    Method  = paste("Method", substr(exposure, 5, 5)),
    HR      = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", estimate, conf.low, conf.high),
    p       = ifelse(p.value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p.value)),
    sig     = p.value < 0.05
  )

wide <- res %>%
  select(Method, Measure, HR, p) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Measure, values_from = c(HR, p), names_glue = "{Measure}_{.value}") %>%
  select(Method,
         `Time in range_HR`, `Time in range_p`,
         `Time above range_HR`, `Time above range_p`,
         `Time below range_HR`, `Time below range_p`)

ft <- flextable(wide) %>%
  set_header_labels(Method = "Method",
                    `Time in range_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Time in range_p` = "p",
                    `Time above range_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Time above range_p` = "p",
                    `Time below range_HR` = "HR (95% CI)", `Time below range_p` = "p") %>%
  add_header_row(values = c("", "Time in range", "Time above range", "Time below range"),
                 colwidths = c(1, 2, 2, 2)) %>%
  set_caption("Association of time in range with cardiovascular events (adjusted)") %>%
  bold(part = "header") %>%
  align(part = "header", align = "center") %>%
  align(j = 2:7, align = "center", part = "body") %>%
  fontsize(size = 10, part = "all") %>%
  padding(padding.top = 3, padding.bottom = 3, part = "all") %>%
  border_remove() %>%
  hline_top(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "header", border = fp_border(width = 1)) %>%
  hline_bottom(part = "body", border = fp_border(width = 1.5)) %>%
  add_footer_lines(c(
    "Cox proportional hazards models with time-varying exposure; each cell is a separate model.",
    "Adjusted for race, ethnicity, sex, age at encounter, time-varying comorbidities, and medication exposures. HR per 10 percentage-point increase; robust SEs clustered by patient. Bold = p < 0.05.",
    "Methods A, B, and C are the three TSH range definitions (A: 0.4-4.5, B: 0.1-10, C: 0.4-6 mIU/L).")) %>%
  autofit()

sig <- res %>% filter(sig)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(sig))) {
  r <- which(wide$Method == sig$Method[i])
  ft <- bold(ft, i = r, j = paste0(sig$Measure[i], c("_HR", "_p")), part = "body")
}
ft

save_as_docx(ft, path = file.path(results, "cox_tir_tar_tbr_adjusted_tir_v2.docx"))

```
